geoip_off.message: The GeoIP foreign IP blocking security feature of the ipTIME router ({url}) is turned off.

portforward_on.title: Port Forwarding Enabled
portforward_on.message: The Port Forwarding feature of the ipTIME router ({url}) has been turned On.

security_csrf_off.name: CSRF Prevention

security_arp_virus_off.name: ARP Virus Protection
security_arp_virus_off.danger: Important packets could be easily intercepted.

security_syn_flood_off.name: SYN Flood Protection
security_syn_flood_off.danger: Traffic floods can overload the router processor.

security_smurf_off.name: Smurf DDoS Protection

security_ip_spoofing_off.name: IP Spoofing Protection

security_inbound_ping_off.danger: Active presence online is exposed to hackers.

security_outbound_ping_off.name: Block Outbound Ping
